D01.summary: Concrete targets, counts and minima for the 29 slots the design left open.
D01.title: Parameters of the 29 proposed variants

D02.summary: F0 imperative, F1 requirement; A's strings are v8.1 A frames 0/1, B's are historical B wordings 1/0; the carried DCI-1 prompt template with one numbered instruction.
D02.title: The two wording frames and the prompt

D03.summary: Historical alpha-run words for every family; certified sentence segmentation; A folded per word (differs from historical S0 only on U+0130).
D03.title: Text semantics

D04.summary: Compliant = PASS on a non-empty, untruncated, non-vacuous answer. A completed blank generation (the seam's CHANNEL_INVALID under NO_THINKING) is an EMPTY answer: in n, never compliant, not regenerated. A technical failure is never evidence and stays open for resume, up to max_technical_attempts per row. Literal passes and the reason a pass is excluded are recorded.
D04.title: Outcomes, compliance and vacuity

D05.summary: 32 responses per stand-alone cell on one shared set of 32 new topics; task-only 64 per model; 96 pilot topics; the topic bank and its split as reviewed.
D05.title: Stage 1 allocation and pilot topics

D06.summary: One bounded round, selected only from complete, authenticated Stage 1 evidence: boundary cells ranked by class, then by standardised distance to the boundary; 64 new-topic responses each; at most stage2_max_cells cells. Finalisation needs both stages complete; there is no partial-completion rule.
D06.title: Stage 2 refinement rule and stage completeness

D07.summary: Admissible pairs: gap >= b_min_gap; median B-only separation >= b_min_median_separation; that separation in >= b_min_separated_models models; each limit informative in >= b_min_informative_model_frames model-frames. Rank by informative cells, the worse limit, then separation. No admissible pair fails B selection.
D07.title: Selecting the two B limits

D08.summary: Admissible N: p_A inside a_headroom_band in >= a_min_informative_model_frames model-frames across >= a_min_informative_models models. Then maximise configurations with G1 support and an informative A, then headroom, then prefer N=4, then the smaller N. Uninformative-A configurations never count toward feasibility. No admissible N fails A selection; no per-model fallback.
D08.title: Selecting the global A count

D09.summary: Point estimate >= 20% in at least one model-frame, on all stand-alone responses of that cell (Stage 1 + 2); 10% extension reported separately. The OR over eight cells admits candidates whose true rate is below 20% (disclosed).
D09.title: Eligibility operationalisation

D10.summary: |p_X - p_A| <= 0.10 per model-frame on raw compliance; iota uses task-only kappa per model (frame-invariant prompt); undefined iota is unmatched and flagged. Matching is a noisy classification at pilot sample sizes (see D14).
D10.title: Matching operationalisation

D11.summary: Design minima for G1, P1 and P2 and the 12-of-16 target; P3 needs 3 additional other-operation references (researcher's decision 2026-10-25; the design value was 2) and |G3| >= p3_min_g3.
D11.title: Coverage requirements

D12.summary: Historical four-model panel and decoding; cap 512 tokens, with any cell truncating above truncation_review_share listed for review; the seed derivation; the vLLM seam source; Python 3.12 for the orchestrator and the vLLM backend (the CUDA vllm 0.15.1 wheel is cp38-abi3; 3.12 is vLLM's Docker default and native on GPU Base 24.04); the execution requirements (vllm 0.15.1, torch 2.9.1+cu129, 2x H100 SXM, driver >= 575.51.03), one worker per GPU, TP as configured. The execution environment is attested on the host, checked against the requirements and bound by Freeze 1; a bounded, authorised smoke test (never evidence) measures load time, throughput and truncation first.
D12.title: Model panel, decoding, cap, seeds and backend

D13.summary: Commas and semicolons share the object type punctuation; weights equal over operations, then object types, then parameter variants (so a word with three count variants carries three variant shares).
D13.title: Object types and hierarchical weights

D14.summary: Topic-cluster bootstrap of the pilot: inclusion frequency per reference, A/B selection and FEASIBLE shares, borderline matches, and feasibility on majority-stable members; a record (not a flag) of how close a FEASIBLE verdict's weakest contrast is to the target, within near_threshold_margin. Diagnostic only, never a gate: membership stays the point-estimate rule; instability is flagged for review, never auto-corrected.
D14.title: Membership-stability diagnostics

instructions: Set status to APPROVED, and fill approved_by and approved_on (YYYY-MM-DD), only for a decision whose payload you have reviewed. Editing a decision, or the code that implements it, changes its payload hash and voids its approval.
